The '''E-series 1-9''' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], also named '''Swiftkick''', was a product of arms manufacturer [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], with only elite members of [[Santhe Security]] using it. In existence by [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], two members of Santhe Security disguised as [[Waiter/Legends|waiters]] in [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] known as the [[Shimmersilk (restaurant)|Shimmersilk]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] carried this powerful and discreet blaster.
